answer: Beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat block mass fakes. Each epoch a beacon draws random agents, who must solve a puzzle in ten minutes, proving live hardware. Silent clones lose deposits, like fish stranded when a lagoon drains. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 machines on duty, about 2,000 POA a month, yet each earns little before capture. Honest agents pay one heartbeat per epoch, as small as a basalt pebble, keeping the reward pool an oasis.
